scripts.lint: npm run lint:code && npm run lint:architecture && npm run test:architecture && npm run lint:spacing && npm run test:spacing && npm run lint:mock

scripts.format:e2e: prettier e2e --write && node scripts/formatting/spacing.mjs --write e2e && prettier e2e --write
